findings.title: Startup error sanitization echoes untrusted RPC text and reflected URL credentials
findings.expected: Startup diagnostics exclude endpoint secrets and arbitrary provider text.
findings.observed: A real local status endpoint reflects a synthetic URL-path token as chain_id. NearContractReader includes it in its network-mismatch message; sanitizeHostStartupError preserves that entire message. The normal CLI prints the returned message.
findings.reproduction: adversarial.mjs: startup exception redaction adversarial reproduction; adversarial-results.json contains the synthetic canary only, no real secret.
findings.impact: Potential credential disclosure/log injection into startup log readers. The provider already sees its URL token; no private key or unrelated database secret was recovered. Startup still fails closed. Existing sanitizer behavior predates M5-E.
findings.remediation: Use a fixed allowlist of safe startup error codes/messages; never copy provider-controlled chain_id or raw error messages into logs. Add adversarial exception/URL-reflection regression coverage.
findings.gate_reason: Resolve before credential-bearing operational startup; this gate does not assert a token-transfer or authorization bypass.

findings.title: Recipient token inspector omits decoded JSON depth guard
findings.expected: Decoded token-view JSON receives the same nesting cap before parsing as other NEAR view clients.
findings.observed: A real HTTP query response with shallow outer JSON and byte-encoded 100-level nested JSON is accepted by TestnetInspector.view despite the shared default JSON depth of 64. The other generic and reconciliation view clients check decoded depth.
findings.reproduction: adversarial.mjs: actual bounded transport still accepts deeply nested encoded token JSON; adversarial-results.json records depth 100.
findings.impact: Declared JSON-nesting protection is incomplete on this inspection path. The 4 MiB outer streaming byte limit and request deadlines still apply; no unbounded response allocation, stack crash, false technical readiness or payment authorization was demonstrated. nativeRecipientPreflight metadata shape validation rejects this array.
findings.remediation: Apply decoded UTF-8/depth validation consistently before exactJson in TestnetInspector.view, with actual-transport encoded-payload tests.
findings.gate_reason: Close the claimed resource-hardening coverage gap before integrating this preflight into an approved experiment.

unresolved_prerequisites.details: No controlled recipient supplied; advisory claims never become cryptographically verified. No nonce/session/FullAccess-key verification is integrated.

Result lacks payout/attempt binding, freshness expiry and reusable authenticated attestation. executionReady is always false and there is no authorizing consumer. Future execution must independently bind and refresh all observations.
Safeguards are a pure inactive local assessment, not wired dispatch controls. No worker/signer exists in host.

Tidepool metadata/storage match. Real transfer/callback compatibility must be measured in a separately approved isolated experiment; proven compatibility is not a prerequisite to proposing that experiment.
No global exporter, latency histograms, backlog/lease/TransferPending gauges or automated alerts. Manual evidence capture and named stop owner could suffice for a one-attempt isolated experiment.
No off-chain decision can settle or release on-chain funds. Unknown outcome must remain locked; no automatic resend.
